scripts.dev: echo "Module Federation requires build + preview. Use: npm start"
scripts.build: npm run build:operations && npm run build:finops && npm run build:shell
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -k -n operations,finops,shell -c blue,green,magenta "npm run preview:operations" "npm run preview:finops" "npm run preview:shell"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @cloudops/operations-mfe && npm run test -w @cloudops/finops-mfe && npm run test -w @cloudops/shell
